item.title: The invisible layoff: AI is quietly locking Americans out of the job market, CEO warns
item.description: February's shocking 92,000 job losses reveal a potential hidden crisis: AI algorithms are allegedly screening out qualified workers while boosting productivity.

item.title: California tech leaders challenge progressive policies as billionaires, businesses flee: report
item.description: Centrist tech leaders, including Garry Tan and Chris Larsen urge business figures to stay in California and fight against policies like a proposed tax on billionaires.

item.title: Paychecks keep rising for American workers, providing boost to household budgets
item.description: The February jobs report showed wage growth accelerated to 3.8% on an annual basis, outpacing economists' expectations despite an increase in the unemployment rate, BLS data showed.

item.title: LARRY KUDLOW: Actions are being taken to get a string of ships through the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Let a bunch of oil tankers sail through the Strait of Hormuz and world oil prices will retreat big time.

item.title: Prediction market Kalshi sued over $54M Iranian leader bets after ‘death carveout’ invoked
item.description: Kalshi was sued over $54 million in bets after invoking a “death carveout" after the killing of Iran’s Ayatollah Ali Khamenei during Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Gas prices surge as Iran conflict rattles global oil markets, pushing US crude above $90
item.description: Rising tensions with Iran are rippling through global oil markets, sending crude prices sharply higher and pushing U.S. gas prices up at the pump.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent forecasts largest bombing campaign yet, says Iran attempting 'economic chaos'
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Iran fights on military and economic fronts as the U.S. launches its biggest bombing campaign against Iranian missile launchers and factories.

item.title: Frito-Lay recalls Miss Vickie's chips over potentially 'life-threatening' allergen risk
item.description: Frito-Lay recalled Miss Vickie's Spicy Dill Pickle chips over an undeclared milk allergen. Certain bags may pose a serious risk to those with dairy allergies.

item.title: Ford wins over Democrats and Republicans as 'most American' brand in new survey
item.description: A major survey of 11,000 Americans reveals Ford as the "most American" brand, beating Coca-Cola, McDonald's and Apple across political and economic divides.

item.title: Samurai swords, WWII flight jacket, meteorite among items left behind by travelers: Unclaimed Baggage report
item.description: From gold-plated golf clubs to meteorites, a new report on traveler's unclaimed baggage from last year reveals the interesting items people are taking with them — and leaving behind.
